scientific_question: Can a nonlinear implicit coordinate field co-generate each expert neuron's c_fc feature vector and c_proj residual-write vector at greater than 200x trainable compression?

theory_reconciliation.neuron_pair_object: Generate the coupled pair (a_j,b_j) used by y(x)=sum_j b_j GELU(a_j^T x+bias_j); never align c_fc and c_proj hidden indices independently.
theory_reconciliation.causal_change: Replace matrix-basis coordinates with per-neuron latent codes decoded jointly as a nonlinear function of residual-channel position. Expert-specific codes avoid measured shared-rotation cancellation; learned layerwise decoders avoid a fixed pseudo-random output image; joint two-sided outputs avoid predicting c_proj from c_fc alone.
theory_reconciliation.not_a_closed_family: This is not a fixed FHT/spectral image, sparse Givens orbit, low-rank additive basis, Kronecker/KFAC span, or tensor-train weight decomposition. The coordinate field is nonlinear in neuron code and residual-channel coordinate and may generate full-ordinary-rank matrices.
theory_reconciliation.not_lora: There is no dense learned dictionary, stored dense base matrix, or additive low-rank residual. All codes, decoder weights, biases, and scales are counted.
theory_reconciliation.mapping_paper_connection: This implements a smooth low-dimensional latent-to-parameter map at layerwise/neuron-pair granularity. A local Jacobian-action term is included because the theorem is local and the residual-link failure is functional.

prior_constraints.feature_does_not_predict_write: The sealed cross-neuron feature-to-write ridge audit recovered only about 0.07 of heldout write function, so the decoder emits independent feature/write values from a shared code rather than tying b_j to a_j.
prior_constraints.shared_rotation_conflict: Layer-shared butterfly expert gradients had mean pairwise cosine -0.14218 and cancellation ratio 2.65e-4, so every expert owns its neuron codes.
prior_constraints.fixed_basis_ceiling: The 209.45x spectral map recovered about 0.382 and the 219.43x maximum KFAC chart about 0.43, motivating a nonlinear coordinate field rather than another wider static basis.

source.terminal_gauge: Collect inputs through the exact terminal model and routing. Fit and score the coupled expert function with both dense matrices used only as the frozen teacher.

candidate.name: layerwise_paired_neuron_coordinate_field
candidate.router_scope: The small top-2 router remains an independently counted non-target component; both expert matrices are generated.

control.name: fixed_decoder_fit_codes_only
control.description: Use the identical initialized nonlinear decoder but freeze decoder weights; fit only neuron codes, hidden biases, and two layer scales.

data_protocol.sampling: Route terminal activations and deterministically sample 128 assigned tokens per expert for each discovery bank and probed layer.
data_protocol.anti_leakage: Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout tokens and tangent probes never affect coordinates, stopping, scales, or selection.

fit_protocol.objective: Equal-expert normalized residual-output MSE plus 0.10 times normalized analytic input-JVP MSE along one frozen Rademacher probe per fitted token.
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered step. No heldout selection, retry, LR/rank/code-width sweep, or threshold adjustment.

evaluation.primary: Exact routed dense-teacher residual-output recovery on untouched terminal activations.
evaluation.local: Analytic input-JVP recovery on an independently seeded frozen Rademacher direction.
evaluation.expert: Score every expert before top-2 mixture aggregation.
evaluation.stability: Compare heldout routed actions from independently fitted discovery A/B fields by cosine.

decision_rule.pass: Passing every gate for both fits authorizes only implementation, exact-count/correctness tests, and a separately preregistered initialization-plus-Mapping-Loss shadow.
decision_rule.fail: Reject this exact six-code, 64-wide field. Diagnose expressivity versus optimization only from preregistered diagnostics; do not sweep code width, hidden width, Fourier frequencies, LR, seed, steps, or thresholds.
